notes.title: New Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We're moving our release date by a few weeks to April 9th. As AoD:S is our first game, we want to make sure it's in the best and most polished state possible before putting it into your hands! 

In the meantime, we're also working hard to get the non-VR version done.

We are confident the game will be worth the wait, and can't wait to see everyone experience it!
